question.text: An electron is projected with uniform velocity along the axis inside a current carrying long solenoid. Then :

options.text: the electron will continue to move with uniform velocity along the axis of the solenoid.
the electron will be accelerated along the axis.
the electron path will be circular about the axis.
the electron will experience a force at $45^{\circ}$ to the axis and execute a helical path.

solution.text: Since $\vec{v} \| \vec{B}$ so force on electron due to magnetic field is zero. So it will move along axis with uniform velocity.
